commands.name: setup
commands.description:
Set up your Agent 365 environment with granular control over each step

Recommended execution order:
  0. a365 setup requirements           # Check prerequisites (optional)
  1. a365 setup blueprint
  2. a365 setup permissions mcp
  3. a365 setup permissions bot
Or run all steps at once:
  a365 setup all                      # Full setup

If you are not a Global Administrator, setup all will print next steps
for a Global Administrator to complete the required consent grants.

commands.name: requirements
commands.description:
Validate prerequisites for Agent 365 setup
Runs modular requirement checks and provides guidance for any issues found

This command will:
  - Check all prerequisites needed for Agent 365 setup
  - Report any issues with detailed resolution guidance
  - Continue checking all requirements even if some fail
  - Provide a summary of all checks at the end

commands.name: all
commands.description:
Run complete Agent 365 setup (all steps in sequence)
Includes: Infrastructure + Blueprint + Permissions + Endpoint

Minimum required permissions (Global Administrator has all of these):
  - Azure Subscription Contributor (for infrastructure and endpoint)
  - Agent ID Developer role (for blueprint creation)
  - Global Administrator (for permission grants and admin consent)

options.description: Show detailed output

Skip requirements validation check
Use with caution: setup may fail if prerequisites are not met

options.description:
AI Teammate agent: setup provisions blueprint and permissions only.
Omit for blueprint-only agent (default): setup auto-creates agent identity SP; no Entra user.
Overrides the aiTeammate field in a365.config.json

options.description: Skip all setup steps and only run agent registration (non-M365 agents only)

options.name: --m365
options.description: Treat this agent as an M365 agent. When set, registers the messaging endpoint via MCP Platform. Default is false (opt-in); omit this flag for non-M365 agents.

options.name: --agent-name
options.description:
Agent base name (e.g. "MyAgent"). When provided, no config file is required.
Derives AgentIdentityDisplayName="<name> Identity" and AgentBlueprintDisplayName="<name> Blueprint".
TenantId is auto-detected from 'az account show' (override with --tenant-id).
ClientAppId is resolved by looking up "Agent 365 CLI" in your tenant.

options.name: --tenant-id
options.description: Azure AD tenant ID. Overrides auto-detection from 'az account show'.

options.name: --authmode
options.description:
Authentication pattern for the agent identity (blueprint agents only).
obo  — on-behalf-of (default); principal-scoped delegated grants; no admin consent needed.
s2s  — service-to-service; app permissions on agent identity; Global Admin needed or PowerShell fallback.
both — delegated grants (OBO) and app permissions (S2S).
Not supported with --aiteammate true.
